Select the adverbials of time in the paragraph.

feedback.end: The adverbials of time “last week” and “next week” add cohesion to the paragraph by connecting the two events.

atoms.b: ((Last week,)) I went to the cinema with my little brother and saw an action film. ((Next week,)) we are going to see a comedy film at a different cinema.

instruction.text: Select the adverbials of place in the paragraph.

feedback.end: The adverbials of place “on a campsite” and “near the campsite” add cohesion to the paragraph by linking the two sentences together.

atoms.b: My family and I are going to stay ((on a campsite)) this weekend. ((Near the campsite,)) there is a small village.

instruction.text: Select the adverbials of number in the paragraph.

feedback.end: The adverbials of number “firstly” and “secondly” add cohesion to the paragraph by creating a time line of events.

atoms.b: Jasmine is baking a cake. ((Firstly,)) she mixes the ingredients in a bowl. ((Secondly,)) she puts the mixture into the oven.

trainers.instruction: Choose the correct adverbials to fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: ((++Over_the_weekend In_the_park)), I went to the beach. ((++At_the_beach At_home)), it was very busy and there were lots of dogs playing in the sand. I left the beach ((++at_5pm in_the_kitchen)) so I could get home in time to cook dinner.

trainers.instruction: Use all the adverbials to correctly fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: ((Next_year)), I am going to run a half-marathon. The half-marathon will begin ((in_the_city_centre)), so I will start most of my training runs there. ((At_first)), I will train by running at least 3 miles a week.
